test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-testing-Everything after `--` in `plan` remains the normal test command's native argv; do not turn it\ninto a shell command string. `plan` runs no baseline, test command, worker copy, or session.\nEach `verify` runs a fresh baseline and never reuses a session.]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-testing-3. Create a temporary directory outside the repository. Keep the root, selector, profile,\n   operators, limits, test argv, and fingerprint inputs unchanged for every verify that consumes\n   its plan.]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-improvement-2. If it survives, read its original expression, replacement, symbol, and line.
   Investigate the contract first. Only for a justified test gap, add or strengthen
   the smallest behavioral test that observes the violated contract. Do not add
   implementation-detail mocks, unrelated tests, or production-code changes made
   only to kill the mutant.]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-improvement-State the production target, test argv, plan profile and fingerprint inputs, selected candidate\nIDs, each candidate's final status, tests added or strengthened, any replan reason, and unverified\nor truncated-away candidates with their rationale.]
test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-improvement-1. Keep `PLAN.json` and verify reports in a temporary directory outside the repository.]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-improvement-Use `hoimin progress --format json` only when every supplied report covers the identical candidate-ID set.
Do not use arbitrary one-candidate or changing-subset verify reports to infer
improvement, stalls, or saturation. When a planned candidate remains unverified, say so. When
`PLAN.json` was truncated, also say that candidates outside its retained partial set were never
enumerated.]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-testing-- `verify` exit 0 means the selected candidates completed with no survivor. Exit 1 means at least\n  one selected candidate survived. Exit 3 means the fresh baseline failed. Exit 4 is incomplete;\n  exit 130 is cancelled. For exits 2, 3, 4, or 130, stop and diagnose before changing tests.]
test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-improvement-3. Run the normal test command. If it fails, repair or report that failure before verifying again.]
test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-testing-2. Run the normal test command. Stop and repair or report a failure before planning.]
test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-testing-Read `candidates[].id` from `PLAN.json`; choose one ID and pass that exact ID to `verify`:]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-testing-- A `plan.source.changed` or `plan.fingerprint_input.changed` rejection means the manifest is\n  stale. Regenerate it before any further verify. Also replan when selector, operators, profile,\n  limits, or test argv must change.]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-testing-1. Inspect changed production Python files, their tests, and the normal test command. Target\n   production code, never test modules. Prefer `--source <dir> --changed`; otherwise use\n   `--file <path>`, `--line`, or `--symbol`.]
test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-testing-`plan` always writes one JSON document to standard output and diagnostics to standard error;\ndo not pass `--format` to `plan`.]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-improvement-2. Keep the plan's root, selector, profile, operators, limits, fingerprint inputs, and test argv\n   unchanged while improving tests. Test-only changes are expected: every verify still runs a\n   fresh baseline with those new tests.]

test_skill_required_workflows[hoimin-mutation-improvement-4. Reverify the same candidate. Confirm that the test passes on the original and
   detects the mutant for the intended behavioral reason. A completed killed result
   without that reason is insufficient evidence of a useful improvement. Investigate
   a remaining survivor only within the agreed budget; a baseline failure, incomplete
   run, cancellation, or error stops the loop for diagnosis.]
